reason: Prose renders the Markdown pipeline's sanitised HTML as its own markup, for security; Mux Markdown would parse and render untrusted source on the client.
Prose's root delegates clicks and keys to the spoilers inside the sanitised HTML; it is not a widget of its own.
The spoiler reveal button is created inside the sanitised HTML, before a compound spoiler, where no React component can be rendered.
A leaf spoiler inside the sanitised HTML becomes its own reveal button; no React component can be rendered there.
Prose's stylesheet styles the elements of the sanitised Markdown HTML, which are plain HTML by design (see the prose.tsx exceptions).
The decorative thumbnail link is removed from the tab order and the accessibility tree; Mux Link drops tabIndex and aria-hidden.
A static blur hides a hidden or NSFW thumbnail; it is not animated, so it does not repaint.
A static blur hides reported text until a moderator chooses Show; it is not animated, so it does not repaint.
Reduced motion must turn off smooth scrolling everywhere, including where a component sets it.
Quote keeps the blockquote element for its meaning; Mux Text cannot render one, and the quoted words inside it are a Mux Text.
ButtonLink repeats Mux Button's own focus ring, built only from Mux's focus tokens, because Mux's later link rule would draw the thinner link ring on it; no single Mux token holds the whole ring.
A field's error must be announced when it appears, and Mux's error parts drop a role prop, so the alert role sits on one inner span that every field wrapper shares.
The two-factor QR code is generated data drawn as an svg, not an icon; Mux has no QR component, and it must stay dark on light to scan.
